input: Find a local beekeeping beginner course

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Without knowing the user's location, it is impossible to identify which courses are actually local to them.
Course availability varies heavily by season; knowing when they want to start narrows down which courses are still open for enrolment.
Beginner courses range from free community workshops to several-hundred-dollar multi-week programmes; budget determines which options are viable.
Some courses are purely theoretical, others include hands-on hive work — knowing which depth the user wants shapes what to look for.
The user may only be available on weekends, prefer a one-day intensive over a multi-week series, or need an online-compatible hybrid option.
Knowing whether this is for one person or a group (e.g. a couple, family, or friends) affects which course formats and pricing tiers are relevant.
Understanding the end goal — hobbyist backyard hive vs. small-scale honey production vs. general curiosity — determines what level of certification or curriculum depth is actually needed.

gold.taskTitle: Find a local beginner beekeeping course
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate and sign up for a beginner-level beekeeping course in their area.

questions.title: What city or region are you based in?
questions.description: Identifies the user's location so that only genuinely local courses are surfaced.

questions.title: When do you want the course to start?
questions.description: Pinpoints the desired start window so only currently enrollable courses are considered.

questions.title: What is your budget for this course?
questions.description: Establishes a spending ceiling to filter out options that are too expensive or to flag free alternatives.

questions.title: Do you want hands-on hive time, or theory only?
questions.description: Clarifies the desired depth of practical involvement, narrowing the type of course to search for.

questions.title: Do you prefer a single day or a multi-week series?
questions.description: Determines the preferred course format and schedule structure so availability can be matched accordingly.

questions.title: Are you signing up alone or with others?
questions.description: Establishes the number of participants, which affects group pricing and minimum enrolment requirements.

questions.title: What is your ultimate goal after taking the course?
questions.description: Understanding the end goal — hobby hive, honey production, or pure curiosity — determines the required curriculum depth and any certification needs.
